name: Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight - Chibi SEES Set
summary: A set of 10 chibi-character accessories (P3 Protagonist, Yukari, Junpei, Mitsuru, Akihiko, Fuuka, Aigis, Koromaru, Ken, and Shinjiro) for all characters. This item is compatible with both Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight and Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight on PS4.
